title: Stoliner Rebbe Clarifies Smartphone Use
body: Stoliner Rebbe's senior mashpi'im clarify his guidance on smartphone use, stressing strict boundaries and warnings against misuse after recent remarks permitting limited use under conditions.

title: Terror Attack on Chareidi Teacher
body: The wife of Reb Yaakov Gerber, a 37-year-old melamed, describes the terror attack that left him wounded. The terrorist ran him down and tried to smash his skull with blows, leaving him injured.

title: Beth Medrash Govoha Raises Kollel Checks
body: Beth Medrash Govoha of Lakewood, NJ, boosts kollel stipends by $40, raising the standard check to $1,140, and increases the Yom Tov bonus to $942.
